business_problem: Fragmented customer data across brands, apps, and marketing systems prevented Allergan from building a unified direct-to-consumer relationship or personalizing its Allē loyalty journey effectively.
solution_summary: Allergan rebuilt its direct-to-consumer engagement stack around Snowflake, Segment, and Twilio Programmable Messaging so consumer interactions from websites, mobile apps, and loyalty experiences could feed one governed customer record. Segment collects and standardizes event data, then loads it into Snowflake to create a single view of each consumer across brands and touchpoints. Product and data-science teams use the Segment-enriched Snowflake data to score audiences and predict relevant offers, products, and content. Those predictions are activated back into applications, websites, and multichannel marketing workflows, while Twilio delivers transactional loyalty messages. Segment reverse ETL and audience-building workflows also remove data silos between analytics, CRM, and downstream engagement tools such as Braze. By keeping collection, storage, modeling, and activation tightly connected, Allergan turned its loyalty program into a faster, more personalized revenue engine.

solution_components.name: Segment
solution_components.role: Collects, standardizes, and routes customer event data from Allergan digital properties into the central data platform.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Stores unified consumer profiles and model outputs as the single source of truth for analytics, audience building, and personalization.

solution_components.name: Twilio Programmable Messaging
solution_components.role: Delivers transactional loyalty and engagement messages to consumers based on platform data and audience logic.

data_flow: Customer events from Allergan websites and mobile apps are captured in Segment, standardized, and loaded into Snowflake as unified profiles. Data-science scores and audience selections are then pushed into apps, sites, and messaging channels such as Twilio so each consumer receives more relevant offers and content.
business_outcome: Allergan turned Allē into a major direct-to-consumer growth engine, generating more than $1 billion in sales since 2021 while improving campaign speed, acquisition efficiency, and consumer engagement.
metrics: 10% reduction in JUVEDERM completed a purchase cost per acquisition
